content: Retention action catalog: agent may give a bill credit up to Rs 500 or a plan discount up to 20% for 3 months; anything above needs a supervisor.
Raise a network escalation when there are 3 or more coverage complaints from one location in 30 days.
Disputed charges are corrected after verification; correction is confirmed to the customer within 48 hours.
Festive retention offer: 2 months at half rental, valid 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-08.
